content_data.meeting_title: Packaging Redesign & Brand Consistency Review for 'FreshBite' Line
agenda_items: Define next steps for vendor selection and prototype development.
Review current 'FreshBite' packaging designs and identify areas for improvement.
Brainstorm innovative packaging materials and printing techniques for sustainability.
Discuss brand guidelines adherence across all new marketing assets.
key_decisions: Prioritized exploration of compostable and recyclable packaging options with procurement.
Established a clear hierarchy for nutritional information and branding elements on all labels.
